<div class="current-group-preview" data-group="water-year-temperature">
<p>Mean temperature from October 1 through the map date. Departures and percentile ranks compare matching calendar-date periods in water years 1991–2020. Each daily mean is (maximum + minimum)/2; days receive equal weight. This is season-to-date context, not a completed-year rank. February 29 references interpolate the February 28 and March 1 cumulative means; missing daily pairs are not filled.</p>
